title: Anti-Replay Protection
description: Prevent replay attacks on sensitive operations like login, registration, and password changes.

enabled.label: Enable Anti-Replay
enabled.desc: When disabled, all replay-protected sensitive endpoints (login, register, change password, etc.) will skip nonce verification.

nonceTimeoutSeconds.label: Nonce TTL
nonceTimeoutSeconds.desc: How long the platform-issued nonce is cached in Redis; requests exceeding this duration will be rejected.

timestampToleranceSeconds.label: Timestamp Tolerance
timestampToleranceSeconds.desc: Maximum allowed deviation (absolute, bidirectional) between request timestamp and server time.
